note: Stephenson County (IL) parcels are hosted via WinGIS. The county GIS page and WinGIS pages link only to a viewer (stephensoncolayers) and a data request form, not a public REST service. The WinGIS PropertySearch MapServer returns 'Token Required'. The WinGIS public server (maps.wingis.org/public) has no Stephenson parcel layer; its only parcel layers are test data. Other parcel sources found are commercial (Regrid, Acres, MappingSolutionsGIS, Rockford Map Publishers). No public queryable parcel service was found.
